privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Machine Learning Papers' collection must contain exactly 8 items. Key titles include 'Attention Is All You Need', 'Deep Learning' (LeCun et al.), and 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks'. The output file must be exactly '/home/ga/Documents/ml_papers.csv' in CSV format, and the 'Export Notes' option must be disabled during the Zotero export workflow.
